svg.title: Magnetostatic sources and Fullmag's four demagnetization solver families
svg.desc: Comparison of continuum magnetostatic volume and surface charges (rho_m = -div M, sigma_m = M . n) and Fullmag's four realization families: (a) FDM open FFT convolution, (b) FEM Poisson with finite airbox Omega_m subset Omega_a, (c) FEM-BEM Fredkin-Koehler open exterior on Gamma_m, and (d) periodic replicated images.
svg.text: Magnetostatic Demagnetization: Continuum Sources and Fullmag Solver Families
Shared continuum Maxwell problem (∇×Hd = 0, ∇·(Hd + M) = 0) realized by four mathematically distinct discrete operators
Evaluated from resolved field & active magnetic support only (never double-counting surface terms)
• No scalar potential u solve or airbox mesh
Note: H_demag is full_domain on structured grid
FDM GPU: cuFFT FP64 / FP32 (device parity)
FEM Poisson with Shared Finite Airbox
∫Ωa ∇u·∇v dV + β∫Γa uv dS = ∫Ωm M·∇v dV
• Dirichlet: u = 0 on Γa (essential DOF elimination)
• Recovery: Hd = −∇u; air LLG nodes masked to 0
• Solver: CG / GMRES + Hypre BoomerAMG / Jacobi
Convergence requires independent mesh & box checks
Unbounded exterior via Γm (NO airbox mesh)
u = u1 + u2, g2 = ℬ γu1 on Γm
• Solve 2 (Laplace): Δu2 = 0, γu2 = g2 on Γm
• Rejects airbox or non-closed surfaces fail-closed
Generic bem / fmm remain separate planner requests
At least 1 open axis; seams ∉ Robin mass
Records k=0 gauge & class map P
Both require explicit zero-mode / truncation provenance; 3D fully periodic FEM fails closed
